title: 第25章 流云碧波阵狩猎第26章 飞鹏鱼外出
content_zh:
“好了，邹师弟，”李松鹤适时接过话题，“此次前来，一则是为了呈上琉璃宗的上供，二则是敬献师尊所需的份额。”
邹修士听罢，微微颔首，随即神色变得凝重起来。
他从袖中轻轻取出两枚玉简，其上流转着淡淡的光芒，记载着青元坊市周遭各势力所应上交的供奉明细。
“李师兄，”邹修士翻阅片刻，语气平稳地继续说道，
“按照规定，今年贵家族需上交供奉灵石共五十枚，另需为师尊上供一百枚，总计一百五十枚灵石。”
听到这里，李松鹤眉头微蹙，不禁疑惑地问道：“这……为何宗门此次增加了三十枚灵石的供奉？”
邹修士轻叹一声，将玉简递给李松鹤，言道：
“此事我也颇为费解，不仅是你们风林岛，其他势力也都相应提高了供奉额度，只是相较之下，你李家似乎涨幅更为显着。”
李松鹤接过玉简，目光扫过其中的文字，眉头不禁更紧了几分。
其他炼气期的势力大多只增了三十至四十灵石的供奉，而李家却独独被要求上交五十灵石。
显然，背后定是有人在琉璃宗内暗中使绊子，欲图针对李家。
然而，李松鹤已离开宗门，如今仅是以附属身份依附于琉璃宗之下。
若此时贸然反抗，无异于以卵击石，只得无奈接受现实。
“这是我们从外海采集所得的二转碧灵桃，”
李松鹤从怀中取出一袋，其中装有一百多颗一阶中品与下品的碧灵桃，他语气略显沉重地说道，
“除了需要扣除的一百五十枚灵石之外，请帮忙将其余部分折算成灵石。”
邹修士见状，瞳孔微微一缩，点了点头。
外海的确是充满机遇所在，对于李家而言，唯有去争机缘，才能在琉璃群岛的风云中，保住风林岛。
神识轻轻一扫，邹修士迅速清点了碧灵桃的数量，并报出了相应的折算价值。
李松鹤闻言，轻轻颔首。

正当邹修士准备掏出灵石进行结算之际，李松鹤却抬手制止了他的动作，缓缓开口道：
“邹师弟，能否为我推荐一套一阶上品的护岛大阵？
此番外出，略有收获，我打算用这些灵石为风林岛增添一些防护。
最近总有些修士不怀好意，时常到岛上释放虫害，实在令人头疼。”
邹修士听后，眉头微蹙，旋即点头，问道：“那你想要的是侧重于防御的大阵，还是攻防兼备的，或是倾向于攻击的类型？”
李松鹤毫不犹豫地答道：“自然是希望以防御为主的大阵。”
在来此的路上，他便已与自己的孙儿商议妥当。
他们二人合力足以对抗数位炼气大圆满境界的修士，因此，在战斗充足的同时，增强防御成为了当务之急。
“好，我去去就来。”邹修士应声而起，步出包厢，不多时便携一物返回。
只见他手中托着三杆精致的阵旗与一块小巧的阵盘，悉数置于桌上。
“这是‘流云碧波阵’，它不仅具备警示功能，还能有效防止窥探，并且具有相当的防御能力。”
邹修士一边展示，一边详尽地介绍道，“在日常运转之时，此阵能够产生大量的迷雾，覆盖整个阵域，足以遮蔽外界窥视。
更重要的是，一旦有练气圆满以下境界修士进入方圆十丈之内，阵法便会立刻发出警讯。
一年下来，大概只需消耗二十块灵石即可维持其正常运作。”
“而若是遭遇强敌，借助阵法之力，它可以抵挡住三位练气大圆满修士连续一个时辰的全力进攻。
而对于练气后期修士，即便是十人齐至，也难撼其分毫。”
“价格如何？”李松鹤关切地询问道。
邹修士略作思量，随即答道：“此阵平日售价为八百五十块灵石，但考虑到是李师兄所要，我愿意以八百灵石的价格出售。”
李松鹤闻言，心中稍作权衡，随即点头应允：“行，我要了。
这是三百一十块灵石，加上先前出售碧灵桃所得，总共九百五十块灵石，正好可以支付今年的供奉与购阵所需灵石。”

说罢，他将灵石递给了邹修士。
邹修士接过灵石，确认无误后，便将三杆阵旗与阵盘一同交给了李松鹤。
李松鹤接过阵法物品，仔细检查确认无误后，正欲起身告辞。
这时，邹修士忽然出言叮嘱：“最近有一条二阶的檀香鲸进入了琉璃群岛海域，你们在外行动时还需多加小心。”
content_en:
"Okay, Junior Brother Zou," Li Songhe took over the topic at the right time, "I came here this time, firstly, to present the Liuli Sect's offering, and secondly, to present the required share to the master."
After hearing this, Brother Zou nodded slightly, and then his expression became solemn.
He gently took out two jade slips from his sleeves. There was a faint light flowing on them, recording the details of the offerings that should be handed over by various forces around Qingyuanfang City.
"Senior Brother Li," Brother Zou browsed for a moment and continued in a calm tone,
"According to the regulations, your family needs to hand over a total of fifty spiritual stones this year, and an additional hundred spiritual stones must be presented to the master, for a total of one hundred and fifty spiritual stones."
Hearing this, Li Songhe frowned slightly and couldn't help but asked in confusion: "Why...why did the sect increase the offering of thirty spiritual stones this time?"
Brother Zou sighed softly, handed the jade slip to Li Songhe, and said:
"I am also quite puzzled by this matter. Not only your Fenglin Island, but other forces have also increased their offerings accordingly. However, in comparison, your Li family's increase seems to be more significant."
Li Songhe took the jade slip, glanced at the words in it, and his brows could not help but tighten a little.
Most of the other forces in the Qi Refining Period only increased their offerings of thirty to forty spiritual stones, but the Li family was alone required to hand over fifty spiritual stones.
Obviously, there must be someone behind the scenes who is secretly scheming within the Liuli Sect to target the Li family.
However, Li Songhe has left the sect and is now only attached to the Liuli Sect as a subordinate.
If you rashly resist at this time, it will be like hitting an egg with an egg against a stone, and you will have no choice but to accept the reality.
"This is the second-turn green peach we collected from the open sea,"
Li Songhe took out a bag from his arms, which contained more than a hundred first-class middle- and low-grade biling peaches. He said in a slightly heavy tone,
"Except for the one hundred and fifty spirit stones that need to be deducted, please help convert the rest into spirit stones."
When Brother Zou saw this, his pupils shrank slightly and he nodded.
The outer sea is indeed full of opportunities. For the Li family, only by fighting for opportunities can they save Fenglin Island amidst the storm of the Liuli Islands.
With a sweep of his spiritual consciousness, Brother Zou quickly counted the number of Bi Ling peaches and reported the corresponding converted value.
When Li Songhe heard this, he nodded lightly.
Just as Brother Zou was about to take out the spirit stones for settlement, Li Songhe raised his hand to stop him and slowly said:
“Junior Brother Zou, can you recommend me a first-order high-grade island protection formation?
This time I went out and gained a little bit. I plan to use these spiritual stones to add some protection to Fenglin Island.
Recently, there have been some monks with bad intentions who often come to the island to release pests, which is really a headache. "
After hearing this, Brother Zou frowned slightly, then nodded and asked: "Then do you want a large formation that focuses on defense, one that is both offensive and defensive, or one that is more prone to attack?"
Li Songhe replied without hesitation: "Of course we want a defense-focused formation."
On the way here, he had already made arrangements with his grandson.
The combined strength of the two of them is enough to fight against several monks who have achieved the Great Perfection of Qi Refining. Therefore, while fighting is sufficient, strengthening defense has become a top priority.
"Okay, I'll come as soon as I go." Brother Zou stood up in response, stepped out of the box, and returned shortly after carrying something.
He was seen holding three exquisite formation flags and a small formation disk in his hands, all placed on the table.
"This is the 'Flowing Cloud and Blue Wave Array'. It not only has a warning function, but can also effectively prevent prying eyes and has considerable defensive capabilities."
While showing it, Brother Zou introduced it in detail, "During daily operation, this array can produce a large amount of fog, covering the entire array area, enough to block outside prying eyes.
What's more important is that once a monk with a level below Qi Perfection enters within a radius of ten feet, the formation will immediately send out a warning.
After a year, it only takes about twenty spiritual stones to maintain its normal operation. "
"And if you encounter a strong enemy,With the help of the formation, it can withstand the all-out attack of three Qi-training Dzogchen monks for an hour.
As for the monks in the late stage of Qi training, even if ten people come together, it will be difficult to defeat them in the slightest. "
"What's the price? Li Songhe asked with concern.
Brother Zou thought for a moment and then replied: "This array is usually sold for eight hundred and fifty spiritual stones, but considering that Senior Brother Li wants it, I am willing to sell it for eight hundred spiritual stones. "
When Li Songhe heard this, he weighed it in his mind, and then nodded in agreement: "Okay, I want it.
This is 310 spirit stones, plus the previous income from selling Bi Ling Peach, a total of 950 spirit stones, which can just enough to pay for this year's offerings and purchase of spirit stones. "
After saying that, he handed the spirit stone to Brother Zou.
Brother Zou took the spirit stone and after confirming that it was correct, handed the three formation flags and the formation plate to Li Songhe.
Li Songhe took the array items, carefully checked them and confirmed that they were correct, and was about to stand up and leave.
At this time, Brother Zou suddenly warned: "Recently, a second-order sandalwood whale entered the waters of the Liuli Islands. You need to be more careful when moving outside. "
